description: Returns the fixed caveat set mirroring ARCHITECTURE.md's seven 'Known Limitations' items verbatim, plus the Boxleiter accuracy-limit note from FORMULATION.md section 2. The UI renders these on every result surface.
docstring:
Return the fixed, run-independent caveat list.

Returns:
    A list of exactly eight Caveat entries: one per ARCHITECTURE.md 'Known Limitations' item 1-7 (keys: 'steamspy_owner_confidence', 'boxleiter_approximation', 'simplicity_proxy', 'no_scraping_demand_gap', 'survivorship_bias', 'competition_historical', 'coarse_filter_boundary'), plus one additional entry ('boxleiter_accuracy_limit') carrying FORMULATION.md section 2's verbatim accuracy note ('per the Gamalytic test, only ~43% of games fall within +/-30% of their true sales using the plain review-multiple method... treat S_i as an ordinal ranking signal, not a point estimate a user should quote as fact'), which FORMULATION.md explicitly instructs to 'record verbatim in reporting.interpretive_caveats'.

Takes no arguments and touches no database -- this is a fixed, code-authored, non-Streamlit-dependent list (module non_goal: 'usable and testable headless').
postconditions: Returns exactly 8 Caveat entries with stable, unique keys across calls and across code versions
body text is a close paraphrase or verbatim quote of the corresponding ARCHITECTURE.md/FORMULATION.md source text, never a newly-invented interpretation of the limitation

edge_cases.input: Called multiple times in one process
edge_cases.expected_behavior: returns equal (by value) lists every time -- purely a function of the hard-coded caveat text, no external state

unit_tests.name: test_returns_one_caveat_per_limitation_with_stable_keys
unit_tests.description: Returns exactly 8 Caveat entries with the documented key set, per the module's own testing requirement.
unit_tests.expected: 8 entries; keys match the documented set exactly

unit_tests.name: test_boxleiter_accuracy_note_present
unit_tests.description: The 'boxleiter_accuracy_limit' caveat's body contains the '43%' figure from FORMULATION.md.
unit_tests.expected: '43%' substring present in that caveat's body
